record.label: Total Hoare triples and termination
record.statement: For a total Hoare triple, the expectation of the postcondition after execution is at least the expectation of the precondition before execution.
record.boundary: If the initial precondition has expectation one, the output state has trace one and the postcondition also has expectation one. For example, suppose a complete measurement produces two equiprobable outcomes and the program aborts on the second. Then the output trace is one half, so the triple with precondition and postcondition $\top$ fails on that input.
